name: stub_with_fallback_pattern
description: Pattern pour importer des modules réels ou leurs stubs avec fallback, utile quand les modules source n'existent pas encore
code:
import sys
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from src.execution_engine import ExecutionEngine
except ImportError:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent / 'stubs'))
    from execution_engine_stub import ExecutionEngine

assert ExecutionEngine.__module__.startswith(("tests", "src"))
